name: SM_Tomato_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): the task for the unclaimed families asks for a baked set per asset, and the surface detail here (see dresses) does not exist in the shared library
pivot: base centre (bbox centre in X/Y, mesh bottom at z = 0), front on -Y
dresses: ripe tomato, about 7.5 cm across, faintly ribbed at the shoulder, green star calyx and stalk stub
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: Sepals are thick (about 1 mm solid) and lie flat rather than curling; their game mesh is a decimation of the source, so its triangles are irregular. Skin is very clean: no cracks at the shoulder, no stem scar ring. No subsurface in the game material, which a tomato needs in back light.
origin_ids_note: the family shares its origin IDs between all of its frames; this asset dresses the placements that show frame 421/22
